verdict.rationale: Data export in open formats is a fair question for a SaaS compliance and entity-management service like CT Corporation, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two probes showing the product pages were unreachable (a Cloudflare challenge on www.wolterskluwer.com, and the legacy host redirecting into it). Nothing in the evidence documents bulk export, open formats, or offboarding, so the verdict is none; confidence is low because the content was never reached rather than shown to lack the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
